accepted_subtypes.label: ID documents
accepted_subtypes.description: ID card, passport, residence permit, or driver's license.

accepted_subtypes.label: Government organization documents
accepted_subtypes.description: Statement, voter registration, or tax bill.

instructions: Documents must include your full name and address.
ID documents must be valid and in date.
Other documents must have been issued in the last 12 months.
For physical documents, all four corners must be visible.
For digital documents, upload the original PDF; screenshots aren't accepted.
document.file_requirements: PDF, JPEG/JPG, or PNG, up to 50 MB per file.
